skill.name: Compare/Position
skill.strategic_description: The player ship remains visible while labels/types update and nearby objects shift: a weapon pickup disappears, shots continue/disappear, and the scene re-resolves into status-panel/weapon-icon/cave-background elements with a rock cluster.

skill.name: Recover/Survive
skill.strategic_description: The player ship remains alive/visible while transitioning out of a pickup-heavy cave scene into an active combat state with enemies, shots, and updated HUD/lives display.

steps: Detect route boundary, emerging hazards, and current safe spacing
Choose a forward path that preserves survival margin
Advance through the transition while suppressing immediate threats
Confirm stable presence and readiness in the new state
Reposition to safety if hazards overwhelm the transition
abort_criteria: No progress toward skill objective after several moves

contract.name: Reposition to Survive
contract.description: Quickly shift the ship to a safer lane when an enemy disappears and a new threat appears on-screen, especially during sudden spawn transitions. Use this to avoid getting trapped by incoming fire or newly visible enemies in Thunder Force III.
